stories.title: Nursing students in Wales pushed into poverty despite existing support, RCN warns
stories.summary: Nursing staff in Wales say staffing levels are not matching the complexity of care patients now need, with too many shifts operating without enough registered nurses to deliver safe and effective care, the Royal College of Nursing says. stories.title: Young people reaching out to Childline for online child sexual abuse rises by 36%
stories.summary: The number of young people reaching out to Childline for support over online child sexual abuse and exploitation rose by more than a third in the last year. stories.title: Only UK aardvark calf born at Chester Zoo, hand-reared by keepers and nicknamed Womble
stories.summary: Chester Zoo keepers have hand-reared a baby aardvark calf, nicknamed Womble, after his mother was unable to produce enough milk to fully support him. stories.title: Warm and sunny bank holiday weekend forecast for Flintshire, with hotter weather to follow
stories.summary: A warm and settled bank holiday weekend is forecast for Flintshire, with temperatures set to peak at 25°C on bank holiday Monday before climbing further into next week. stories.title: Welsh Government confirms childcare expansion as Labour calls for funding clarity
